Marta: Partner upload landed: s3://redwood-incoming/partners/zenith/zen-7b/zenith_v1.weights.tar.gz
Marta: Vendor supplied sha256=3f8a9c2b4e5d7f1a8b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01 and detached sig zen_v1.sig
Oliver: I'll pull and verify now. Who has the Zenith signing key fingerprint? @Morgan
Morgan: Fingerprint reported by Zenith: 9A3F D12B 7E9C 4F3A 88BC 2D9E 1F6A 3B5C 9A3F
Morgan: Propose we fetch their pubkey, add to org keyring, and record key metadata in KMDB (vendor=zenith)
Leo: Tokenizer archive present too: s3://redwood-incoming/partners/zenith/zen-7b/tokenizer_v1.tar.gz
Leo: I'll stage both to staging with CMK rewrap (cmk-ingest-2026) and tighten ACLs
registry-bot: registry-bot: queued artifact validation job #99921 for thread 1934100000
Oliver: Running checksum and GPG locally.
Oliver: Command:
```
sha256sum zenith_v1.weights.tar.gz
# 3f8a9c2b4e5d7f1a8b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01  zenith_v1.weights.tar.gz
```
Oliver: GPG verify:
```
gpg --verify zen_v1.sig zenith_v1.weights.tar.gz
# gpg: Signature made ...
# gpg: Good signature from "Zenith Release Signing <releases@zenith.ai>"
```
Oliver: Not in our keyring initially — fetched key from keyserver and uploaded fingerprint+proof to KMDB: /kmdb/keys/zenith/9A3FD12B
Sophie: Security checklist: need original object origin, transfer method (s3-multipart), S3 upload IP ranges, vendor contact email, checksum, and detached sig. No registry write until ACLs, KMS CMK usage, and KMDB entry are validated. :lock:
Leo: Copy plan:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-incoming/partners/zenith/zen-7b/zenith_v1.weights.tar.gz s3://redwood-staging/zenith/zen-7b/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id cmk-ingest-2026
```
Leo: Copy complete. Staging paths (private, kms cmk-ingest-2026):
- s3://redwood-staging/zenith/zen-7b/zenith_v1.weights.tar.gz
- s3://redwood-staging/zenith/zen-7b/tokenizer_v1.tar.gz
registry-bot: registry-bot: artifact validation #99921 update: checksum PASS, signature PASS, tokenizer found, KMS envelope PASS. Metadata extracted: vendor=zenith, origin=s3, transport=s3-multipart, ingest_ts=1934100000
Marta: Thanks. Jay can you run FP32 baseline + PTQ/4-bit run on our quant bench. Use redwood/quant-bench:stable and staging bucket.
Jay: Yes. I'll schedule a baseline on the "latency-small" evaluation set tomorrow AM. Expect first quant+eval results in ~48h.
Sophie: I'll do ACL/policy/KMS review today. If nothing unexpected, sign-off EOD with comment approved_by:Sophie
Morgan: I'll prepare the registry entry template and hold until Sophie posts approved_by tag. Entry will include metadata, key fingerprint, validation logs link, retention policy, and CVE check summary.
Leo: Ingest audit logged: s3://redwood-logs/ingest/1934100000.log — contains copy records, kms rewrap audit, gpg output, and sha checks
registry-bot: registry-bot: pre-write gate waiting for human sign-off (Sophie). Add tag approved_by when signed.
Marta: Marking this as in-flight. Please update thread with Sophie sign-off and final registry URL. :thumbsup:
